# gitea_issue_attachment (Resource)

`gitea_issue_attachment` manages an issue attachment.

Import expects the resource ID in the form `owner:repo:issue_index:attachment_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitea_issue_attachment" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
  issue_index      = 1
  source_path      = "${path.module}/attachment.txt"
  name             = "attachment.txt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issue_index` (Number) The issue index.
- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.
- `source_path` (String) The local source file to upload.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The attachment name. Defaults to the source file basename.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_id` (Number) The attachment ID.
- `created_at` (String) The attachment creation timestamp.
- `download_count` (Number) The attachment download count.
- `download_url` (String) The attachment download URL.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size` (Number) The attachment size in bytes.
- `uuid` (String) The attachment UUID.

## Import

Using `import` blocks in Terraform v1.5.0 and later:

```terraform
import {
  to = gitea_issue_attachment.example
  id = "<owner>:<repo>:<issue_index>:<attachment_id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import` in Terraform v1.4.0 and earlier:

```shell
terraform import gitea_issue_attachment.example <owner>:<repo>:<issue_index>:<attachment_id>
```
